name: thesis-daganzo-baseline-v1
missing_neighbor: Use that neighbor's scheduled target headway, as provided by the existing SUMO observation adapter.
timetable: Keep the current SUMO timetable and fleet; do not substitute TransitDuet's fixed-360-second timetable.
policy_training: None. Reuse all completed v3 learned-policy evaluations without selection or retraining.
primary_comparison: Compare each rule plus early60 with normalized MC-WM and H2O+ using the same early60 execution layer.
native_reference: Report standalone rule results separately; contrasts with guarded learned policies do not isolate the learning algorithm.
scope: Additional fixed-parameter references on the existing evaluation days, not new independent confirmation.
attribution: daganzo_duet reproduces TransitDuet's Daganzo-style holding formula in the current SUMO task; forward_proportional implements the heuristic already specified in thesis equation 5-005. Neither is claimed as an exact reproduction of Daganzo 2009.
